Innovative research shows cement kilns powered by clean energy could capture more CO2 than they emit via calcium looping!
Evidence: lab model, energy intensive, 2050 targets
#Aletheia #ClimateTech 🌐

Researchers at ETH Zurich and Heirloom Carbon Technologies demonstrate that integrating calcium looping DAC into electric cement kilns could offset 78% of emissions.

Resulting Judgement: (+0.75, +0.74) — Lesser Good

Rigorous lifecycle modeling outlines a credible path to mitigation, though execution hurdles remain high.
Integrity: Trustworthy (Hypocrisy: 1.2, Uncertainty z: 1)

- ETH Zurich Study: PASS (+0.9, +0.8) — Rigorous prospective lifecycle modeling.
- Heirloom Collaboration: COND (+0.7, +0.6) — Scalability tied to clean energy.
Researchers evaluated different energy scenarios for running calcium looping DAC plants, showing net-negative potential by 2050 if decarbonization succeeds.

The Bright Side:
Turning a major industrial polluter into an atmospheric carbon sink is a monumental climate breakthrough.

The Breakdown & Plane Error:

The Unavoidable Lie: This technology solves current emissions today without massive green energy scaling.
